brand.name: Highzcore
brand.tagline: Your account. Your money. Our bot.

hero.eyebrow: Automated trading on your own Vantage account
hero.title: You keep your money where it is. The bot does the trading.
hero.body: Open a Vantage account in your own name, fund it, and give our bot permission to trade it. Permission to trade — never permission to withdraw. We never hold your funds.

one.title: Open your Vantage account
one.body: In your own name, funded by you, held by Vantage. We never touch the money.

two.title: Give trade permission
two.body: Sign Vantage's limited power of attorney. It lets our bot place trades on your account. It does not let anyone withdraw.

three.title: Watch it trade
three.body: Every position the bot opens on your account, live in your dashboard. Disconnect whenever you want.

performance.title: The live record
performance.body: Every trade the bot has made, published in full.
performance.unavailable: Live figures are unavailable right now.

pricing.title: {price} a month
pricing.body: A flat software subscription. Pay for longer and save 5%.

custody.a: No. Your account is opened with Vantage in your own name and funded by you. We are granted permission to trade it and nothing else. We cannot withdraw from it, and neither can anyone else but you.

stop.q: Can I stop at any time?
stop.a: Yes. You can detach the bot from your Vantage account whenever you want, and cancel the subscription. There is no lock-in period.

cost.a: $20 per month for the software. Longer terms are 5% cheaper. There is also a performance fee, which is configured inside Vantage's management panel and paid out by Vantage — it never passes through us.

losses.a: Yes. Trading carries risk of loss, and an automated strategy is no exception. Past performance does not predict future results. Only trade money you can afford to lose.

broker.a: Vantage supports the account structure this needs: you hold your own account, and a manager is granted trade-only permission on it. That is what keeps your funds in your name.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.intro: Five things happen, in this order. At no point do we hold your money.

open.title: You open your own Vantage account
open.body: The account is in your name, with Vantage, not with us. You complete their verification directly.

fund.title: You fund it
fund.body: You deposit with Vantage. The money is in your account, under your control, the whole time.

lpoa.title: You sign Vantage's limited power of attorney
lpoa.body: This grants permission to place trades on your account. It does not grant permission to withdraw, transfer, or move funds anywhere. That restriction is enforced by Vantage, not by our promise.

trade.title: Our bot trades it
trade.body: The bot places the same positions on your account that it places on the master. You see each one in your dashboard.

disconnect.title: You can disconnect at any time
disconnect.body: Detach the bot from your account in Vantage and cancel your subscription. Your account, and the money in it, stay yours throughout.

custody.title: We never hold your funds
custody.body: There is no stage of this where your money sits with us. You deposit with Vantage and withdraw from Vantage. The only money you pay us is the $20 software subscription.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.intro: One price for the software. 5% off any term longer than one month.

performanceFee.title: The performance fee
performanceFee.body: Separately from this subscription, a performance fee is configured inside Vantage's management panel and paid out by Vantage. It is calculated and taken by Vantage on your account — it never passes through us.

noRefund.title: Before you subscribe
noRefund.body: You need a funded Vantage account linked to us for the bot to trade. Subscribing on its own does not start anything.

risk.title: Risk disclosure
risk.intro: Read this before you subscribe or link an account.

loss.title: Trading carries risk of loss
loss.body: You can lose money, including more than you expected to. Leveraged trading can lose money faster than unleveraged trading. Only trade money you can afford to lose entirely.

past.title: Past performance does not predict future results
past.body: Any record we publish describes trades that have already happened. It is not a forecast, a projection, or a promise. A strategy that has been profitable can stop being profitable without warning.

ai.title: AI can make mistakes
ai.body: The bot makes decisions automatically. It can misread a market, act on bad data, or behave in ways we did not anticipate. Software, connections and the broker's systems can all fail. None of these are hypothetical.

noAdvice.title: This is not financial advice
noAdvice.body: Nothing on this site is a personal recommendation. We do not know your circumstances, and nothing here is tailored to them. If you need advice, get it from someone licensed to give it.

custody.title: What we can and cannot do with your account
custody.body: We are granted permission to place trades on your account. We cannot withdraw from it or transfer money out of it. Your funds are held by Vantage in your own name throughout.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.intro: This creates your Highzcore account. Your Vantage account is separate, and you open that in your own name.
signup.acknowledge: I have read the risk disclosure and understand that trading carries risk of loss, that past performance does not predict future results, and that the bot can make mistakes.

errors.acknowledge: Please confirm you have read the risk disclosure.
errors.password: Password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.generic: We could not create your account. Please try again.

verifyEmail.title: Check your email
verifyEmail.body: We have sent a confirmation link to {email}. Click it to verify your address — nothing else happens on your account until you do.
verifyEmail.noEmail: No email? Check your spam folder, or
verifyEmail.resent: Sent. It can take a minute to arrive.

errors.invalid: That email and password do not match an account.
errors.unverified: Please verify your email address first. Check your inbox for the link.
errors.linkExpired: That link has expired or has already been used. Sign in, or request a new one.
errors.missingCode: That link was incomplete. Please use the full link from your email.
errors.generic: We could not sign you in. Please try again.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.intro: Enter your email address and we will send you a link to set a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way.

errors.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.password: Password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.generic: We could not update your password. The link may have expired.

onboarding.title: Getting set up
onboarding.intro: Four steps. You can stop and come back — this page remembers where you are.

account.title: Open your Vantage account
account.body: Open it in your own name through our partner link. You complete Vantage's verification directly with them.

fund.title: Fund it
fund.body: Deposit with Vantage. The money stays in your account, in your name, the whole time. We never hold it.

link.title: Link to our manager ID
link.body: Sign Vantage's limited power of attorney and give us your MT5 login so we can confirm the link. Trade permission only — never withdrawal.

subscribe.title: Subscribe
subscribe.body: $20 a month for the software. The bot does not trade your account until this is active.

status.pending: You have not linked a Vantage account yet.
status.linked: Your Vantage account is linked. Subscribe to start trading.
status.active: Your account is linked and your subscription is active.
status.suspended: Your account is not currently being traded. Contact us if this is unexpected.

onboarding.notReady: We could not load your account just now. Reload the page, and contact us if it keeps happening.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.draft: Draft — under legal review. Not binding until published.

permission.title: What you grant us
permission.body: You grant permission to place trades on your Vantage account, and nothing else. We cannot withdraw funds, transfer funds, or move money out of your account. That limit is enforced by Vantage under the limited power of attorney you sign with them, not by our undertaking alone.

subscription.title: The subscription
subscription.body: The $20 monthly fee is for access to the software. It is not a payment into your trading account and it is not an investment. A performance fee is configured inside Vantage's management panel and is calculated and paid out by Vantage; it does not pass through us.

noGuarantee.title: No guarantee of results
noGuarantee.body: We do not guarantee any level of return, and nothing on this site should be read as a promise of one. You may lose money. See the risk disclosure.

termination.title: Ending the arrangement
termination.body: You may cancel your subscription and detach the bot from your Vantage account at any time. Detaching is done in Vantage; cancelling is done here. Both are needed to stop trading entirely.

attribution.title: Attribution
attribution.body: Charts on this site are powered by TradingView.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.draft: Draft — under legal review. Not binding until published.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: Your email address, your subscription and payment records, and your Vantage MT5 login number. We do not collect or store your Vantage password, and we never ask for it.

use.title: What we use it for
use.body: To run your account: confirming your account link, managing your subscription, and sending you notifications you have not opted out of.

share.title: Who we share it with
share.body: Our payment providers, to take payment, and Vantage, to confirm the link between your account and our manager ID. We do not sell your data.

rights.title: Your data
rights.body: You can ask us for a copy of what we hold about you, or ask us to delete it. Deleting your account here does not close your Vantage account — that is held by you, with them.

footer.tagline: Automated trading on your own Vantage account.
footer.disclaimer: Trading carries risk of loss. Past performance does not predict future results. We never hold client funds — your account is held with Vantage in your own name, and we are granted permission to trade it only, never to withdraw.
